title: Ring of Salving
summary: Restore 2 additional HP whenever you heal another creature.

fields.Saviour’s Allure: Add 2 HP when you heal another creature. Self-healing does not qualify.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by Omeluum at Ebonlake Grotto after his parasite quest.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
